title: ER-TEST: Evaluating Explanation Regularization Methods for Language Models
findings: Explanation regularization (ER) with a relaxed 'Order' alignment criterion was found to be effective in reducing bias (measured by False Positive Rate Difference) against group identifiers like 'Muslim' in hate speech detection tasks. This approach yielded the lowest bias among all models on both seen and unseen datasets, significantly outperforming the baseline model without ER.
